test_title: PYST 07: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statements and conclusions carefully. Assume the statements are absolutely true, even if they contradict commonly known facts. Based solely on the statements, determine which of the conclusions logically follow.

Statements:

All cars are vehicles.

Some vehicles are bikes.

No bike is a truck.

Conclusions:

(1) Some vehicles are not trucks.

(2) No car is a bike.

(3) Some cars are bikes.

(4) Some trucks are vehicles.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29820c3bc743e77de18a82c70d30fb7084ad0cc660dd1d3412f0c02e78b396a7.png] 

Conclusions:

(1) Some vehicles are not trucks → **True **(As, Some vehicles are bikes, No bike is a truck. so, Some vehicles are not trucks holds true)

(2) No car is a bike → False (As, there is no direct relation between car and bike, so it can be a possibility, but not definite)

(3) Some cars are bikes → False (As, there is no direct relation between car and bike, so it can be a possibility, but not definite)

(4) Some trucks are vehicles → False (As, there is no direct relation between trucks and vehicles, so it can be a possibility but not definite)

Thus, Only (1) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
